facts: Race The Vibe 2026 is scheduled for 26-27 September 2026 on DJ 678A in Nicolae Balcescu commune.
The public traffic notice states the event interval as 10:00-21:00 on both days.
Road traffic is closed on DJ 678A between km 17+200 and km 18+300 during 10:00-21:00.
The event notice states entrance and participation are free.
Vehicles over 7.5 t are restricted on the DJ 678A sector between DJ 678 Cocoru and DN7 Milcoiu; alternative routes are published.
